units.title: Actual cosine-grid precision admissibility
units.reader_note: The matrix bounds are shown first; actual grid, hypotheses, formula proof and exact Lean are folded below.
units.statement: Every actual cosine-grid precision lies between the identity and κ times the identity and is positive definite.
assumptions: \(d\in\mathbb N,\ d\ge2,\ \kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge2\). Fix any actual \(O\in O(d)\), including either determinant sign. The assertion holds pointwise; no Haar law or private-randomness premise is needed.

For source indices \(i=1,\ldots,d\), let \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), and \(A=O\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)O^\top\). Lean uses zero-based \(i.\mathrm{val}+1/2\); the focused Test proves that index alignment.

Matrix order is quadratic-form order: \(I_d\preceq A\) means \(A-I_d\) is positive semidefinite, and \(A\preceq\kappa I_d\) means \(\kappa I_d-A\) is positive semidefinite. This does not require every entry to be nonnegative. The finite-support definition covers all real coordinate vectors.

Positive definiteness, symmetry, scalar interval bounds and both orthogonality identities are produced or obtained from the source orthogonal-group input; none is a new public hypothesis. The dimension premise is retained exactly even though the cosine envelope works for every angle.

The actual Gaussian consumer is \(\pi_A=N(0,A^{-1})\) on Euclidean space with Lebesgue reference volume and real exponent \(d/2\), including odd dimensions. Its positive precision comes from this producer. Known-normalizer products independent of \(O\), full Appendix C.4 calculus/minimizer, moments/Krylov, adaptive/precision/cost/TV adapters and both complete main bounds remain separate.

notation.text: Actual source precision and literal source diagonal values.

steps.title: Bound each actual diagonal value
steps.text: Since κ≥2, its cosine coefficient is nonnegative. Multiply the standard bounds −1≤cos θᵢ≤1 by that coefficient to obtain the exact source interval, without a spectral-window premise.
steps.lean: hcoef is derived from hκ; hvalue consumes Real.neg_one_le_cos, Real.cos_le_one and exact real arithmetic.

steps.title: Form the two positive diagonal differences
steps.text: Use the actual scalar differences as diagonal entries. Nonnegative diagonal entries make these two actual diagonal matrices positive semidefinite, including their symmetry.
steps.lean: hdiaglo/hdiaghi prove the actual matrix identities entrywise; hlow/hhigh call the canonical PosSemidef.diagonal fact on the proved scalar bounds.

steps.title: Conjugate through the actual rotation
steps.text: Use OOᵀ=I from full real orthogonality. Distributing the actual products identifies the two differences with conjugates of the proved positive diagonal matrices. Positive semidefiniteness is preserved under this actual conjugation.
steps.lean: hO, hstar and the distribution identities hloweq/hhigheq feed hAlo/hAhi via PosSemidef.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same.

steps.title: Produce strict positivity
steps.text: Add the positive identity matrix to the first semidefinite difference. Every nonzero vector has strictly positive identity quadratic form, so the actual precision is positive definite. This is an output consequence.
steps.lean: hpos combines the canonical PosDef.one and PosDef.posSemidef_add with hAlo, then cancels the subtracted identity.

steps.title: Consume the actual precision in its Gaussian density
steps.text: The focused Test applies the producer to this same literal A and passes its positive-definite output to the existing canonical positive-precision Gaussian density theorem. The actual inverse-covariance Gaussian equals the actual quadratic-potential density, with no supplied positivity or correct-density hypothesis.
steps.lean: Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumAdmissibility obtains hA from actual_precision_admissible and calls GaussianPrecisionDensity.multivariateGaussian_eq_withDensity_of_posDef A hA. This existing shared node is a consumer dependency, not a producer proof parent.

units.lean_statement: Exactly the sealed actual cosine-grid precision, source d>=2/kappa>=2/fullO, two Loewner differences and internally produced PosDef.
units.lean_proof: The exact production theorem is extracted adjacent to these formula steps. Standard real positivity and orthogonal-conjugation facts are canonical dependencies; no supplied scalar envelope, symmetry, positivity or Gaussian-correctness premise is added.

No exact determinant/known-normalizer/spectral-multiplicity theorem, target moment/Krylov concentration, adaptive/private-seed/transcript/output law, Gaussian target/TV change-of-kappa, deterministic/expected/finiteprecision/bitcost adapter or either main lower bound is closed.
